lines: d36: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Duc Du is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d36: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d36: 🕯️ Duc is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d36: Ashford watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d36: 🕯️ Duc Du is dead — lockjaw. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d36: What Duc kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d36: "Duc's gone." Alejandra looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Duc." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d36: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Leomarys blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Swimmer (Level 1). Cross water freely. Rivers are roads to you.
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Star Navigation (Level 1). North Star is constant. Find the Big Dipper, follow the pointer stars. You always know north.
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Water (Level 1). You know where fish hold: seams, eddies, shade lines. The water stops being a surface and starts being a map.
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Stalk (Level 1). Move unseen. Close distance without being noticed.
d36: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d36: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Duc Du, 36 days. The mantle passes to Leomarys Becerra.
d36: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Leomarys Becerra, 41 — a Sailor. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Lucky Rock, Echo Location, Beard Moss, War Cry.
d36: The village's quarrel was with Duc — and Duc is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d36: At the grave, Jada, Rebecca, Alejandra and 4 more speak for Leomarys — "Duc trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d36: The fire knew Leomarys before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
d65: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Leomarys Becerra is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d65: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d65: 🕯️ Leomarys is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
